title: Reliability-Aware Checkpoint Selection for Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.39934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Checkpoint selection in domain generalization often relies on source-validation accuracy, yet the selected checkpoint need not provide reliable probabilities on unseen target domains. Source-target distribution shifts can alter accuracy rankings, while accuracy alone does not measure predictive probability quality. We identify an empirical selection opportunity within fixed training trajectories: reselecting among checkpoints with near-optimal source accuracy can improve mean target probability quality with small observed changes in mean target accuracy. We study accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC), which retains checkpoints within a tolerance of the best source-validation accuracy and ranks them by source reliability. Our reference rule aggregates within-set normalized negative log-likelihood (NLL) and class-wise calibration error (CwECE) using $D_\infty$. translated_title: 面向领域泛化的可靠性感知检查点选择
translated_abstract: 领域泛化中的检查点选择通常依赖于源验证准确率，然而被选中的检查点在未见的目标领域上未必能提供可靠的概率预测。源-目标分布偏移可能会改变准确率的排名，而准确率本身并不能衡量预测概率的质量。我们在固定的训练轨迹中识别出一种经验性的选择机会：在源准确率接近最优的检查点之间重新选择，可以在平均目标准确率仅发生微小变化的情况下，提升平均目标概率质量。我们研究了准确率约束下的可靠性选择（AC），该方法保留位于最佳源验证准确率容差范围内的检查点，并按源可靠性对它们进行排序。我们的参考规则使用 $D_\infty$ 聚合集合内归一化负对数似然（NLL）和类别级校准误差。AC 不使用任何目标数据，既不需要额外训练，也无需其他改动。
tldr: 提出准确率约束的可靠性检查点选择方法AC，仅利用源域可靠性指标（NLL与CwECE的聚合）在近最优准确率的检查点中重新选择，无需目标数据和额外训练即可提升未见目标域上的概率预测质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC), which reselects among near-optimal-accuracy checkpoints by ranking source reliability through aggregated NLL and class-wise CwECE, improving target probability quality without using target data or additional training.
